verdict.rationale: Termius is an SSH client and terminal for managing hosts, keys, snippets, port forwarding and SFTP. Interactive git history rewriting (deleting, editing, squashing or reordering commits) is a source-control capability outside this product category, and nothing in the evidence shows Termius ships any git tooling. Running git commands inside a remote shell would be a user-side workaround, not a Termius capability.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can interactively rewrite history by deleting, editing, squashing, or reordering commits
